name: daily_briefing
description: Search broadly across multiple news outlets for the last 24 hours and return a concise, source-diverse daily briefing.

current_date.description: The current date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

steps.thought: Get a broad baseline set of stories from the last 24 hours.

args.query: news site:reuters.com OR site:apnews.com OR site:bloomberg.com OR site:wsj.com OR site:ft.com after:{{current_date}}

steps.thought: Pull high-signal wire/business reporting from the last 24 hours.

args.query: news site:bbc.co.uk OR site:theguardian.com OR site:aljazeera.com OR site:dw.com after:{{current_date}}

steps.thought: Add international coverage from the last 24 hours.

args.query: news site:nytimes.com OR site:washingtonpost.com OR site:latimes.com OR site:usatoday.com after:{{current_date}}

steps.thought: Add major US paper coverage from the last 24 hours.

args.query: news 24 hours site:economist.com OR site:newyorker.com OR site:theatlantic.com after:{{current_date}}

steps.thought: Add some analysis/weekly outlets if anything was posted in the last 24 hours.
Synthesize: 5–10 key stories, one-line why-it-matters, notable divergences across outlets, and a diverse source list; prioritize items clearly published within the last 24 hours.
